title: The test objects $X[S]$
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme with structure morphism $\pi_X\colon X\to\Spec\Z$. The
functor
$$
u_X\colon *_{\mathrm{proét}}\longrightarrow X_{\mathrm{proét}},\qquad
S\longmapsto X[S]:=\Spec LC(S,\Z)\times_{\Spec\Z}X\to X ,
$$
is the composite of $u$ ([def-sfb-profinite-to-proetale]) with base change
$V\mapsto V\times_{\Spec\Z}X$ along $\pi_X$. If $S_i$ runs over the finite
quotients of $S$, then $X[S]=\lim_i\coprod_{S_i}X$.

proof.text:
Weakly étale morphisms are stable under base change. So base change along
$\pi_X$ is a functor $(\Spec\Z)_{\mathrm{proét}}\to X_{\mathrm{proét}}$
([def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]), and $u_X$ is a composite of two functors.

For the formula, $\Spec LC(S,\Z)=\lim_i\coprod_{S_i}\Spec\Z$ is a cofiltered
limit along affine transition morphisms. Fibre products commute with such
limits and with finite coproducts, which gives the formula.
